mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25 percentage points over a three-month period signals an imminent monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month increase in total employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a rapidly improving labor market that is likely to trigger inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals strong consumer demand that is likely to be followed by inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average during a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% signals aggressive policy to combat inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0% during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that is likely to generate wage inflation and prompt monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts index (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which typically correlates with broader economic expansion and positive corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises month-over-month.
